answer: Make every new agent burn a fixed amount of tokens in a transaction whose memo carries its public key. Validators check the chain: the burn exists, went to an unspendable address and names that key; only then does the agent join the roster. Burned coins never return, so a hundred identities need a hundred separate burns, and splitting one wallet across keys only divides one budget. That receipt is the kernel of the check; no whisper of goodwill replaces it, and the public knoll of burns is auditable. Limit: a rich attacker can still pay, so the burn must exceed what a new seat can earn.
